title: Restaurant switch resets state
summary: Fresh browser rerun on the dev harness confirmed that switching from Dev Restaurant to Second Dev Restaurant resets tab/filter state and reloads data in the new restaurant context.

assertions.expected: Switching restaurants resets the current tab/filter/page state.
assertions.actual: Started from `?restaurantId=11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111&bookingRef=BR-102&tab=queue` on the Queue tab, then switched to Second Dev Restaurant and landed on `?restaurantId=22222222-2222-4222-8222-222222222222` with the Delivery Log tab active and the bookingRef/tab params removed.

assertions.expected: The page reloads data for the new restaurant context.
assertions.actual: After reload, the switcher showed `Second Dev Restaurant`, the search input was cleared, and the Delivery Log rows changed to the second restaurant dataset (3 rows rendered, including DEV123/DEV456 entries).

steps: Opened a fresh browser session at http://localhost:3000/dev/ops-email-delivery and captured an initial annotated screenshot.
Set Search field to Booking Ref, searched for BR-102, then switched to the Queue tab to create non-default state.
Captured the pre-switch URL `?restaurantId=11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111&bookingRef=BR-102&tab=queue` and a before-switch screenshot.
Opened the Restaurant switcher and selected `Second Dev Restaurant`.
Captured the post-switch URL `?restaurantId=22222222-2222-4222-8222-222222222222`, a post-switch screenshot, and a reload check confirming cleared search state plus second-restaurant data.
frictions: The first post-switch render still exposed the old switcher label in DOM text until a reload; a reload check confirmed the new restaurant context and cleared state.
